## File: facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/paraphraser/paraphrase.py

Prompts

```
['run the paraphrase CLI tool to generate English paraphrases from input text using back-translation', 'run the gen_paraphrases function to produce multiple paraphrases of an English sentence via French back-translation', 'run TransformerModel.from_pretrained to load a pretrained fairseq transformer model with moses tokenizer and sentencepiece BPE', 'run the en2fr translate method to convert an English sentence into French for back-translation', 'run the fr2en translate method with a specific expert index to generate a French-to-English paraphrase']
```
